class.name: OcgGraphic3dZlayersettings
class.brief_description: Structure defines list of ZLayer properties.
class.description: ! Structure defines list of ZLayer properties.

method.name: Graphic3d_ZLayerSettings
method.description: Default settings.

method.name: Lights
method.description: Return lights list to be used for rendering presentations within this Z-Layer; NULL by default. NULL list (but not empty list!) means that default lights assigned to the View should be used instead of per-layer lights.

method.name: SetLights
method.description: Assign lights list to be used.

method.name: Origin
method.description: Return the origin of all objects within the layer.

method.name: OriginTransformation
method.description: Return the transformation to the origin.

method.name: SetOrigin
method.description: Set the origin of all objects within the layer.

method.name: CullingDistance
method.description: Return the distance to discard drawing of distant objects (distance from camera Eye point); by default it is Infinite (distance culling is disabled). Since camera eye definition has no strong meaning within orthographic projection, option is considered only within perspective projection. Note also that this option has effect only when frustum culling is enabled.

method.name: SetCullingDistance
method.description: Set the distance to discard drawing objects.

method.name: CullingSize
method.description: Return the size to discard drawing of small objects; by default it is Infinite (size culling is disabled). Current implementation checks the length of projected diagonal of bounding box in pixels for discarding. Note that this option has effect only when frustum culling is enabled.

method.name: SetCullingSize
method.description: Set the distance to discard drawing objects.

method.name: IsImmediate
method.description: Return true if this layer should be drawn after all normal (non-immediate) layers.

method.name: SetImmediate
method.description: Set the flag indicating the immediate layer, which should be drawn after all normal (non-immediate) layers.

method.name: IsRaytracable
method.description: Returns TRUE if layer should be processed by ray-tracing renderer; TRUE by default. Note that this flag is IGNORED for layers with IsImmediate() flag.

method.name: SetRaytracable
method.description: Sets if layer should be processed by ray-tracing renderer.

method.name: UseEnvironmentTexture
method.description: Return flag to allow/prevent environment texture mapping usage for specific layer.

method.name: SetEnvironmentTexture
method.description: Set the flag to allow/prevent environment texture mapping usage for specific layer.

method.name: ToEnableDepthTest
method.description: Return true if depth test should be enabled.

method.name: SetEnableDepthTest
method.description: Set if depth test should be enabled.

method.name: ToEnableDepthWrite
method.description: Return true depth values should be written during rendering.

method.name: SetEnableDepthWrite
method.description: Set if depth values should be written during rendering.

method.name: ToClearDepth
method.description: Return true if depth values should be cleared before drawing the layer.

method.name: SetClearDepth
method.description: Set if depth values should be cleared before drawing the layer.

method.name: ToRenderInDepthPrepass
method.description: Return TRUE if layer should be rendered within depth pre-pass; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetRenderInDepthPrepass
method.description: Set if layer should be rendered within depth pre-pass.

method.name: PolygonOffset
method.description: Return glPolygonOffset() arguments.

method.name: SetPolygonOffset
method.description: Setup glPolygonOffset() arguments.

method.name: ChangePolygonOffset
method.description: Modify glPolygonOffset() arguments.

method.name: SetDepthOffsetPositive
method.description: Sets minimal possible positive depth offset.

method.name: SetDepthOffsetNegative
method.description: Sets minimal possible negative depth offset.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
